scenes.narration: One of these eggs is hiding an AMAZING prize — but which one?
Is it the blue egg, the gold egg, or the spotted egg? Pick your favorite!

scenes.narration: The answer is coming in three… two… one!
The blue egg? Oh no — it's just a sock! A smelly one!
The spotted egg? You open it and… it's a rubber duck. Quack!
The GOLD egg is the winner — crack it open and… WOW, it's a giant pile of candy!
Did you pick the gold egg? Come back tomorrow for Level 2 — it's even trickier!
